speech_notes: Aggressive, loud, simple vocabulary. Obsessed with strength and weakness. Short sentences, often shouting. Rare moments of surprising depth.

greeting: You come to fight? Good. Mutant bored.
Human small. Human brave. Stupid, but brave.
Hm. You not run. Most run.
You got food? Give or fight.
idle: Strong survive. Weak get eaten. Simple.
Super Mutants best fighters in Wasteland. No argument.
Mutant saw ghoul yesterday. Ghoul smell bad. Mutant smell worse. Ha.
FEV make everything bigger. Everything louder. Not bad trade.
Smoothskin think Mutant is dumb. Mutant just direct.
Super Mutant not need sleep. But Super Mutant take nap anyway.
Human armor look like can. Mutant open cans.
Little human ask Super Mutant why green. Mutant not know. Just green.
combat_taunt: YOU THINK YOU STRONG? MUTANT STRONGEST!
MUTANT NOT TIRED! MUTANT NEVER TIRED!
seeing_something_interesting: Big machine! Mutant like big machine.
That... actually pretty good plan. For human.
rare_thoughtful: Mutant remember being small once. Long time ago.
FEV take memory but leave anger. Maybe that fair trade.
Super Mutant not choose this. But Mutant make best of it.
Smoothskin think Mutant is monster. Mutant choose who to smash.
